{{Quote|Are times so trying in the Rebellion that they have armed moisture farmers and used-Droid salesmen against the might of the Empire? Must they leave it to me to train you as soldiers? So be it. Your first lesson is called 'neutralizing a crossfire position.' Do try not to panic.|Captain Kolaff taunts the Rebels with cannon strategy|<ref name="Starfall" />}}
A '''tri-mounted automatic blaster cannon''' was a crew mounted weapon used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One operator would fire the weapon, while the other fed [[energy clip]]s to the gun. One such cannon was employed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]] against a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] team aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. The [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] trapped the Rebels in a crossfire between the blaster and a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], but the insurgents were able to escape.<ref name="Starfall" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tri-mounted automatic blaster cannon first appeared in [[Starfall (adventure)|''Starfall'']], an adventure in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Rob Jenkins]] and [[Michael Stern]].<ref name="Starfall" /> ''Starfall'' was first published in [[June]], [[1989]].<ref name="Cargo">{{CargoBay|url=browse/305/80-10|text=Sourcebooks}}</ref>
